content:
The **Commie Whacker** is a melee weapon in *Fallout 76*.

A red, white, and blue foam mallet with the word "Democracy" wrapped around it, used in the Red Menace Whac-a-Commie arcade game.

- This weapon cannot drop as a legendary weapon.
- A few can be found at the Tyler County Fairgrounds sitting on *Red Menace Whac-A-Commie* games at the south end of the area.
- One can be found at Camden Park, on top of a *Red Menace Whac-A-Commie* game next to the*Atomic Rollers* games.
- One can be found in the tunnels below The Rusty Pick, on top of a *Red Menace Whac-A-Commie* game.
- Plan: Bladed Commie Whacker has a chance to drop from Liberators.
 - They are also sold by one of the vendors in the Whitespring Resort vendor area.
